name: Data Cleaning Processor
description: Clones a source table into a protected clean_ table and applies planner-authored SQL transforms to it. The planner decides the exact cleaning; the source table is never mutated.

parameters.name: arguments
parameters.description: JSON string of parameters defined in contracts.py. For 'run_cleaning': table_name (str), statements (list of planner-authored SQL strings, may use {table} and {source} placeholders), optional output_table (str).
